subject: prd/channel-inbox
statement: When emitting a bulletin, `pyxis inbox` shall address the output to the relaying agent as a relay-to-the-operator instruction, and for the version advisory shall include the remedy (bump the pinned version and converge).
rationale: the human hears it only if the agent relays; the remedy rides along
fit_criterion: rendered output names the relay action and, for the advisory, the pin-bump-and-converge remedy
